KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. pana
   C. nene
   D. zito

2. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.

3. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.

4. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

5. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. watoto
   B. kitoto
   C. mato
   D. mitoto

6. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

7. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

8. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.
   B. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   D. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.

9. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Anga.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Huyo na Hao and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Anga and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
